summary.title: Executive Summary: Impact at a Glance
insights: India's ML researchers are making their mark with 71 papers at NeurIPS 2025, including 7 spotlight and 1 oral presentations that demonstrate the quality of research.
Positioned globally, India contributes 1.2% to the body of work at NeurIPS 2025.
Analysis of 33 first authorship and 29 majority authorship collaborations reveals trends in research leadership and international collaboration.
The India ML research landscape shows a mix of 32 academic and 12 corporate contributions, with leading institutions demonstrating significant research impact.

insights: The top 5 contributing countries were: United States, China, GB, HK, SG.
